designation: IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
jurisdictionNote: Supreme Court of India. Apex court with original, appellate and advisory jurisdiction under Articles 131-143 of the Constitution. Hears Special Leave Petitions under Article 136, bail in exceptional circumstances, and matters of national importance.

party_designation.state: Union of India through the Attorney General of India

localRules: All petitions must be filed through an Advocate-on-Record (AOR) registered with the Supreme Court of India.
Supreme Court Rules, 2013 govern procedure and filings.
E-filing is mandatory through the Supreme Court E-Filing portal.
Certified copies of all impugned orders must be annexed.
Index of documents and list of dates are mandatory.
All copies to be legible and paginated.
